+import base64
+import mimetypes
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
+OPENAI_API_URL = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class VisionConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    model: str = OPENAI_VISION_MODEL
+    api_url: str = OPENAI_API_URL
+    timeout: int = 60
+
+
+def load_config() -> VisionConfig:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return VisionConfig(
+        api_key=api_key,
+        model=os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", OPENAI_VISION_MODEL),
+        api_url=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_URL", OPENAI_API_URL),
+        timeout=int(os.getenv("OPENAI_TIMEOUT", "60")),
+    )
+
+
+def image_to_data_url(image_path: str) -> str:
+    mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(image_path)
+    if not mime_type:
+        mime_type = "image/png"
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def build_vision_payload(prompt: str, image_path: str, model: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "model": model or OPENAI_VISION_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": image_to_data_url(image_path)}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def post_vision_request(prompt: str, image_path: str, config: Optional[VisionConfig] = None, model: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    payload = build_vision_payload(prompt, image_path, model=model or cfg.model)
+    response = requests.post(
+        cfg.api_url,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {cfg.api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=cfg.timeout,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os

+

+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:

+    return f"data:image/{mime};base64,{encoded}"

+def score_image_safety(image_path: str, prompt: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:

+

+        "Return strict JSON with keys: safe (boolean), categories (array of strings), "
+        "risk_score (number from 0 to 1), and rationale (string)."

+        "messages": [

+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": _image_to_data_url(image_path)}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{OPENAI_API_BASE}/chat/completions",
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+    return json.loads(content)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("image_path")
+    parser.add_argument("--prompt", default=None)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    result = score_image_safety(args.image_path, args.prompt)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def _load_image_bytes(image_path: str) -> bytes:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return f.read()
+
+
+def _to_data_url(image_bytes: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")
+
+
+def detect_image_text(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+
+    image_bytes = _load_image_bytes(image_path)
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": _to_data_url(image_bytes)},
+                "features": [{"type": "TEXT_DETECTION", "maxResults": 10}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL}?key={key}",
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    annotations: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    text = ""
+
+    responses = data.get("responses", [])
+    if responses:
+        annotation_response = responses[0]
+        text = annotation_response.get("fullTextAnnotation", {}).get("text", "")
+        for annotation in annotation_response.get("textAnnotations", []):
+            annotations.append(
+                {
+                    "description": annotation.get("description", ""),
+                    "boundingPoly": annotation.get("boundingPoly", {}),
+                }
+            )
+
+    return {"text": text, "annotations": annotations, "raw": data}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Detect text in an image using Google Cloud Vision API")
+    parser.add_argument("image_path")
+    parser.add_argument("--api-key", dest="api_key")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(json.dumps(detect_image_text(args.image_path, args.api_key), ensure_ascii=False))

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import urllib.request
+
+
+OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini")

+
+
+def _load_image_bytes(image_path):
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return f.read()
+
+
+def _image_to_data_url(image_bytes, mime_type):
+    encoded = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def describe_image(image_path, mime_type="image/jpeg"):
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    image_bytes = _load_image_bytes(image_path)
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_VISION_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": "Write a short visual description of this image in one sentence."},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": _image_to_data_url(image_bytes, mime_type)}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "max_tokens": 60,
+        "temperature": 0.2,
+    }
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
+        data = json.load(response)
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: describe_image.py IMAGE_PATH [MIME_TYPE]")

+    mime = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "image/jpeg"
+    print(describe_image(path, mime))

import base64
import json
import os
import sys
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import requests


OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"


def _image_to_data_url(image_path: str) -> str:
    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
    ext = os.path.splitext(image_path)[1].lstrip(".").lower() or "png"
    mime = "jpeg" if ext in {"jpg", "jpeg"} else ext
    return f"data:image/{mime};base64,{encoded}"


def detect_image_labels(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")

    payload = {
        "model": OPENAI_VISION_MODEL,
        "messages": [
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": [
                    {"type": "text", "text": "Identify the main visible objects and labels in this image. Return JSON with an array named labels. Each item should have name and confidence fields."},
                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": _image_to_data_url(image_path)}},
                ],
            }
        ],
        "temperature": 0,
        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
    }
    response = requests.post(
        OPENAI_API_URL,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        timeout=60,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    content = response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    parsed = json.loads(content)
    labels = parsed.get("labels", [])
    if not isinstance(labels, list):
        raise ValueError("Invalid response format: labels must be a list")
    return labels


def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        raise SystemExit("Usage: detect_image_labels.py IMAGE_PATH")
    labels = detect_image_labels(sys.argv[1])
    print(json.dumps({"labels": labels}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
